name: Marcus Quinn
bio: Marcus opened Iron & Ember in 2012 after a decade coaching in other people’s gyms. He runs the strength programs and still coaches the 5:30am crowd.

name: Jonah Reyes
bio: A former amateur boxer who turned his footwork into a coaching career. Jonah runs the HIIT and boxing classes with a loud playlist and a quiet eye for technique.

name: Dev Nair
bio: Dev teaches yoga and mobility for people who lift, run and sit at desks. Expect clear cues, honest modifications and a very long exhale.

name: Dex Holloway
bio: Dex coaches the heavy lifts and the engine-room conditioning. He loves a good deadlift, a better warm-up and explaining why your knees do that.
